goal:
ADVISE add-edge-relay (first pass). Architecture rigor. Author family is fable (Claude). You are Astra (gpt-6-astra), the other-family gating reader. High blast: a new public UDP listener on the production host, authorisation, and a pre-1.0 protocol dependency.

WHY (from proposal.md): A browser cannot speak Iroh. It reaches a Media-over-QUIC relay only by WebTransport, which needs a UDP port it can address and a certificate it trusts. A call with more than a handful of people also needs each sender to upload once and a relay to fan out. Mjolnir has neither today. A spike on 2026-11-20 ran iroh-live-relay (github.com/n0-computer/iroh-live at 747b1bd) in a guest behind a published UDP port and a browser played a broadcast, but only with a self-signed certificate, a host-side TCP forward and a page loaded from localhost. The change adds a host service, mjolnir-relay, beside the gateway: WebTransport on UDP 443 at one configured name with a certificate from the gateway's issuer, an Iroh endpoint for native clients, a token required for every session, no ticket pulls, off by default.

ORDER YOU MUST FOLLOW (blind pass):
1. Read openspec/changes/add-edge-relay/proposal.md, the living specs openspec/specs/site-certs/spec.md and openspec/specs/edge-auth/spec.md, and the anchored code. Do NOT open design.md or tasks.md yet.
2. Write a 10-line independent take: what you would pin, what you would refuse, and one tradeoff. These are concerns the author must have answered, not a competing design.
3. Then open openspec/changes/add-edge-relay/design.md, openspec/changes/add-edge-relay/specs/edge-relay/spec.md and openspec/changes/add-edge-relay/tasks.md and compare against your take. Steelman it. Skip the section 'Unverified hypotheses' when judging completeness: a later spike stage resolves those before any build.
4. Write openspec/changes/add-edge-relay/reviews/2026-11-20-advise.md. Its first lines must be exactly one of:
> **ADVISE:** accept
or
> **ADVISE:** send-back
followed by
> **READER:** astra-arch-review
> **SPAWN:** <your spawn dir>
Then your blind take and notes in the body. Do not write accept-with-nits. On send-back, add one unchecked box per owed item to openspec/changes/add-edge-relay/tasks.md.

Judge in particular: whether deny-by-default is actually stated as testable requirements; whether the certificate and private-key handling (gateway user issues, root copies to the relay user) is sound against the living site-certs spec; whether fixing only the t/<owner id>/ prefix here and deferring the rest to add-relay-room-auth leaves a gap in which the service could ship open; whether 'the host can read media' is handled honestly; and whether anything in the spec cannot be tested.

anchors.invariant: gateway is TCP only; certificates hot-swap on SIGHUP
gateway runs as User=mjolnir with CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE; the controller is root
--gateway alone never restarts the controller; each flag owns its unit
owner id is a canonical base58 32-byte id
published UDP ports are the per-guest primitive and are not changed here

out_of_scope.item: Minting room tokens and the path layout under t/<owner id>/
